projects.title: The invisible shield
projects.description:
Euro Edil – Safety and Protection for Every Building 

Karrota's rabbits are very fond of companies that deal with the construction and protection of buildings.

data.content: EuroEdil is a company specializing in thermal and waterproofing solutions for various buildings, including roofs, enclosing walls, and swimming pools across Albania.

EuroEdil wanted to enter the market with a memorable and impressive logo. Based on the company's philosophy, we designed the logo using the initials "E" and "D", with colors symbolizing protection from weather conditions and the ongoing care of professionals for every project.
We also developed strategies for social media and the complete visual concept to be applied across these platforms, creating artistic and engaging creatives.

Our goal was to build a trustworthy and professional image for EuroEdil, showing that the company offers not just services, but sustainable and efficient solutions that enhance comfort, safety, and value in every space. Our communication is not only informative but also inspiring, guiding clients toward smart alternatives for their future.
